name: empowerms
description: Static HTML + CSS builds for the Empower Mississippi refresh. The homepage is **settled** — `dist/final.html` is the agreed build, the About Us, Team and Solutions sets were decided on 2026-08-05, and on 2026-08-07 Empower chose one template for all three solution detail pages, The Studio for The Empower Podcast and The Dome for Capitol Chat. Four sets are open: **EPIC** (the research arm, three readings), the two Join Us destinations — **Email Sign Up** and the **Ambassador Landing Page** — and **Donate**, two readings each. The alternatives every decision was made from still build, as reference.
